name: Underdark
title: The Underdark: The Lightless Lands
description: The Underdark is a vast subterranean world that stretches beneath the entire continent of [[Faerûn]].
wiki: The Underdark is a place of endless tunnels and massive caverns. It is divided into three layers: the Upperdark, the Middledark, and the Lowerdark. Each layer has its own unique ecosystem and civilizations, ranging from the drow and duergar to the alien mind flayers and beholders.
